formula: mean(abs(close[j]-close[j-1]) / 0.25, j=t-19..t), available after bar t closes
interpretation: Trailing empirical estimate of next-five-minute absolute close movement; direction-neutral magnitude, not profit expectancy or an exit target
parameter_choice: Fixed simple 20-observation trailing arithmetic mean, no fitting, labels, model scores, targets, PnL or inspected test outcomes used to choose parameters; no horizon scaling
resets: Any non-5-minute interval including scheduled closures, contract identity change, missing identity/completion, nonfinite/nonpositive or inconsistent raw OHLC; require 20 fresh valid returns
missing: NaN with explicit status and sample count, never zero-filled; a valid flat window gives ready zero and fails a positive spread hurdle
spread_source: Existing es_session_cost_v1 B1 session_spreads, ticks per side
gate: expected_move_ticks >= inherited minimum_expected_move_to_spread * session_spread_ticks; S3 ratio remains 2
cost_scope: Gate compares one-side configured spread only; full B1 two-side spread, slippage and commission remain charged in outcomes
activation: Opt-in expected_move_contract in LivePolicy; no installed manifest/registry changes; research only
source: Raw FeatureRuntimeState.to_frame and historical raw ES OHLC, shared function before model imputation or feature alignment
asof: Completed bar close; existing app bar-availability/freshness gates still apply. Historical availability retains predeclared offline bar-close assumption.
